* Checks whether vector is near to zero within a specified tolerance.
     *
     * @param Tolerance Error tolerance.
     * @return true if the vector is near to zero, false otherwise.
     */
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsNearlyZero(T Tolerance=UE_KINDA_SMALL_NUMBER) const;

* Check whether X, Y and Z are nearly equal.
     *
     * @param Tolerance Specified Tolerance.
     * @return true if X == Y == Z within the specified tolerance.
     */
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsUniform(T Tolerance=UE_KINDA_SMALL_NUMBER) const;

static TAutoConsoleVariable<bool> CVarUpdateRigidBodyScaling(TEXT("p.UpdateRigidBodyScaling"), true, TEXT("Updates the rigid body scaling for simulation when the actor scaling is changed \n Default: true."));
